name: clinicaltrials
description: ClinicalTrials.gov (NIH/NLM registry of over 600k clinical studies). The CLI searches studies, fetches full study records and their version history, autocompletes conditions, interventions, sponsors and facilities, and returns registry statistics and field metadata, all through the site's internal /api/int endpoints.

commands.name: search-studies
commands.summary: Search or list clinical studies by condition, keyword, intervention, sponsor, location or NCT IDs, with facet filters, sorting and offset paging. Returns compact study hits.

params.name: cond
params.description: Condition or disease search area, e.g. 'breast cancer'. Use suggest --dictionary Condition for canonical terms.

params.name: term
params.description: Other terms: free-text search over NCT ID, acronym, titles, keywords and more. Supports Essie expression syntax (AND/OR/NOT, AREA[Field]value).

params.name: intr
params.description: Intervention or treatment search area, e.g. 'tamoxifen'

params.name: spons
params.description: Sponsor or collaborator name search area

params.name: ids
params.description: Restrict to these NCT IDs, comma-separated, e.g. NCT00001372,NCT04368728

params.name: aggFilters
params.description: Facet filters as comma-separated 'facetId:key key' groups, e.g. 'status:rec not,sex:f'. Facet ids and keys come from the aggFilters block of count-studies (e.g. status keys: not=not yet recruiting, re

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated field pieces to return (see get-field-metadata) (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (the UI uses up to 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: count-studies
commands.summary: Get the total number of matching studies and per-facet counts (status, sex, phase, study type, …) for a search, without listing studies.

commands.name: get-study
commands.summary: Get the full record of one study by NCT ID: protocol (description, eligibility, arms, outcomes, locations, contacts), results if posted, and derived data. Uses the public REST API v2.

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated field pieces or section names to return, e.g. 'NCTId,BriefTitle,EligibilityCriteria' or 'ProtocolSection'. Leave empty for the full record. (Sent to the site as "fields".)

commands.name: suggest
commands.summary: Autocomplete or normalize a condition, intervention, lead sponsor or facility name before searching.

commands.name: get-field-metadata
commands.summary: Get the study data structure: every field with its piece name (used in fields/sort/AREA[] expressions), type, description and rules.

params.name: includeIndexedOnly
params.description: Include fields that are indexed only (searchable but not part of the record)

params.name: includeHistoricOnly
params.description: Include fields that exist only in historic versions of records

commands.name: list-search-areas
commands.summary: List the search areas (term, cond, intr, …), their query param names, and the weighted fields each one searches.

commands.name: get-stats
commands.summary: Get registry statistics: total studies, recruiting and registered counts by location and study type, registrations and results by year, and the last update date.

commands.name: get-api-spec
commands.summary: Get the OpenAPI 3 (YAML) spec of the public ClinicalTrials.gov REST API v2, the reference for query syntax, filters and field names.

notes: robots.txt disallows /search, /expert-search and /api/v2/*, so every command uses the internal /api/int endpoints the web app calls.

search-studies was only recorded with filter.ids (My Saved Studies page). The cond/term/intr/spons/locStr params are inferred from list-search-areas, whose 'param' value gives each area's query name. Check them with count-studies before relying on them.
aggFilters syntax is 'facetId:key1 key2,facetId2:key'. Get the valid facet ids and keys from the aggFilters array returned by count-studies.
Field and sort names are 'piece' names from get-field-metadata (e.g. BriefTitle, OverallStatus, LastUpdatePostDate).
Study IDs look like NCT########. get-study returns large records; the default fields omit resultsSection, so request it explicitly if needed.
Text fields contain HTML entities (e.g. /) and some descriptions are HTML.

Saving studies is stored only in browser localStorage, and the download dialog sent no recorded request, so neither is available as a command. Location autocomplete uses Google Places and is not exposed.

dropped.name: get-study-version
dropped.summary: Get a historical version of a study record (version 0 = the original registration) to see how it changed over time.

params.name: version
params.description: Version number, starting at 0. Available versions are listed in get-study's history.

dropped.verifyNote: The internal history endpoint returns 403 and the public v2 API has no version-history equivalent.
